subject: Resignation
detail: HGS (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr DHIRAJ KUMAR VASHISTA as WHOLE TIME DIRECTOR of the Company w.e.f. the close of business hours on November 18, 2026.

subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
detail: HGS (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

subject: Press Release
detail: HGSINDIALT: HGS (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 27, 2026, titled HGS (India) H1 total income at Rs 30.04 Cr, up 45.2% HoH; PAT at & Rs 7.51 Cr, issued in connection with the Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results of HGS (India) Limited (the Company) for the half year ended 30th September 2026.
